nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: How GLUE works now
GLUE architecture: Website, GLUE folder, GLUE Home, GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: GLUE is a local-first system composed of four parts: a Svelte website on GitHub Pages, a JSON-based data folder, a Tauri desktop app (GLUE Home) that serves as the library engine, and optional cloud infrastructure for sync and signaling

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON-based local data storage
nodes.rationale: No database (ADR 0009); data is JSON files with specific structure: mco.json (index), profiles/, collections/, with tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, duplicates, backups

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 tray app and local library engine
nodes.rationale: The library's engine when running; serves website on the local computer as its screen through a local link; Rust-based (since 0.52); handles analysis, DJ library syncing, shared sync, backups

nodes.label: GLUE Home's Rust engine: collection stores, jobs, analysis queue, repairs
nodes.rationale: One persistent Rust engine per GLUE Home instance; applies tab edits, saves to disk, runs analysis pipeline, repairs parts written by other computers, handles DJ library imports and syncing

nodes.label: Local link: HTTP API at 127.0.0.1:47400-47409
nodes.rationale: Secure communication between GLUE website and GLUE Home; serves hello, filesystem operations, cache, RPC engine calls, WebSocket lease and attach; every route except hello/connect requires token

nodes.label: Collection: a library with music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses
nodes.rationale: A collection is GLUE's unit of library; stored as collection.json with lists of tracks sharded into JSON files; can be private or shared (in cloud sync form)

nodes.label: Track: a song with status (linked, missing, unlinked) and metadata
nodes.rationale: Songs are identified by rootId + relPath (in music folder) or importPath (from DJ library); have analysis, tags, prep info (cues, grid, BPM), and can have multiple copies in shared collections

nodes.label: Shared form: cloud-synced collection structure with copies, members, and shared state
nodes.rationale: When a collection is synced to cloud, it takes a shared form with copies[computer] for each device's song versions, members listing each computer's music folders, shared files snapshot and log in GLUE Cloud

nodes.label: ADR 0009: No database; JSON files are the store
nodes.rationale: GLUE's data is stored as JSON files in the GLUE folder, not a relational database; this enables local-first operation and file-based backups

nodes.label: ADR 0007: OS access only through src/platform/
nodes.rationale: All operating system interactions (file access, storage handles, IndexedDB) go through a platform abstraction layer to isolate OS specifics from business logic

nodes.label: ADR 0104: GLUE Home is the library's engine
nodes.rationale: When GLUE Home runs, it becomes the engine that the website uses as its screen; the website is only the UI layer, not a direct data operator

nodes.label: Profile: an artist alias with id, name, colour, BPM range
nodes.rationale: One or more profiles (artist identities) can use a GLUE folder; signed in, the account keeps a merged list; deleted profiles are tombstoned globally

nodes.label: Analysis: quality verdict, BPM, key, bandwidth, bit depth from audio files
nodes.rationale: GLUE analyses audio in the Rust engine (GLUE Home) or browser workers; produces verdict and tier (hi-res, lossless, lossy), bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key, fingerprint, spectrogram, waveform

nodes.label: DJ library support: Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Traktor, Apple Music, Serato
nodes.rationale: GLUE imports and stays synced with DJ app libraries (crates/glue-interop in Rust); cues, loops, grids are read from all and written only to Engine DJ and Rekordbox as allowed

nodes.label: Engine DJ two-way sync: playlists, cues, loops, grids, metadata
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's djsync.rs performs three-way merge of Engine DJ's cues, loops and grids against GLUE's prep and last-agreed values; writes only while Engine DJ is closed; playlists stay in Engine DJ's own collection

nodes.label: WebRTC streaming: songs streamed between devices over peer connections
nodes.rationale: Songs on one GLUE Home are sent to other devices over WebRTC, signaled through GLUE Cloud; player fetches bytes in pieces (256 KB, then 2 MB) as needed from a streaming service worker

nodes.label: Duplicate detection: fingerprints and name matching with certainty scoring
nodes.rationale: Duplicates are found by fingerprints (same recording) and name + length matching; grouped with certainty 0-100; GLUE Home computes groups in Rust when it runs, otherwise the browser does

nodes.label: ADR 0182 implementation: djdrives.rs, djlists.rs, djsync.rs handle collection and drive syncs
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home 0.73 reads Engine DJ tree from Collection database, writes playlist changes there with new free ids, then propagates to each drive's copy (only changed entries), repairs GLUE-only lists once, catches up drive songs

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: optional Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object for accounts and signaling
nodes.rationale: Cloud infrastructure for optional accounts, device pairing, shared collections, profiles sync, WebRTC signaling; collections and audio never stored there, only metadata and connectivity

nodes.label: Shared sync: three-way merge of collection changes, pushed to GLUE Cloud, pulled by devices
nodes.rationale: In cloud-synced collections, GLUE Home (0.54+) or browser performs merge3 per field; clashes wait in a box; files marked changed are checked, full resync every 30 minutes; per-computer fields reconciled per-device

nodes.label: crates/glue-audio: Rust native audio analysis engine, line-for-line port of JavaScript
nodes.rationale: Native analysis in GLUE Home since 0.47; produces same results as browser workers using JavaScript numbers; DSD converted to 88.2 kHz PCM; decodes FLAC exactly; held to TypeScript by golden tests

nodes.label: crates/glue-store: Rust library store implementation, byte-for-byte match with TypeScript
nodes.rationale: CollectionStore ported to Rust in GLUE Home 0.52; one store per collection; held to TypeScript by tests/golden/store golden tests

nodes.label: crates/glue-interop: Rust DJ library parsers for Rekordbox, Traktor, Apple Music, Serato, Engine DJ
nodes.rationale: Rust versions of src/core/interop parsers; includes Engine DJ m.db (SQLite) reading; held to JavaScript by tests/golden/interop and tests/golden/import golden tests

nodes.label: crates/glue-engine: GLUE Home's main engine with stores, jobs, analysis, repairs, DJ sync
nodes.rationale: One engine instance per GLUE Home; orchestrates collection stores, background analysis, DJ library syncing, shared sync, backups, reminders; answers /rpc engine calls; e2e tests use glue-engine-test binary

nodes.label: crates/glue-rtc: Rust WebRTC connections, ICE, peers, channels, song streaming
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's peer connections over WebRTC; manages candidates, states, activity, song byte transfers; each connection's findings fed to engine in order on one thread
